title: Merkle-distributor airdrop on Base: 100k claimants, average proof depth 17. Optimize the claim() function for gas. Three changes ranked by impact.
description:
Concrete situation: Solidity 0.8.x airdrop contract on Base mainnet (~2s blocks, ~0.01 gwei base fee). Claim function takes (uint256 index, address account, uint256 amount, bytes32[] proof). Storage: mapping(uint256 => uint256) for claim bitmap. Currently uses OZ MerkleProof library + standard pattern. Per-claim gas observed: 73,500 (median).

Identify THREE optimizations and rank by gas savings. For each:

1. **The change** — code-level diff sketch, not a vague concept.
2. **Estimated gas saved** — number with a stated assumption ("~5,000 gas, dominated by avoided SLOAD").
3. **The trade-off** — security weakening, code complexity, ABI compatibility, replay risk.

Examples of valid optimizations:
- Bitmap pack: store 256 claims per slot (already done in OZ MerkleDistributor — assess if relevant)
- Calldata vs memory for proof array (cheap; how much?)
- Custom hash assembly for keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...)) inline assembly
- Skip-zero-amount short-circuit
- Eliminate the address-from-storage read by using msg.sender (and document the receiver-bind change)
- Replace OZ verify() with hand-rolled inline-assembly tree walk

Common bait answers:
- "Use a non-EVM chain." Out of scope — assume Base.
- "Use ZK proofs." Different verification primitive. Skip.
- "Reduce proof depth by smaller tree." 100k claimants → log2(100k) ≈ 17 is already minimum.

Voters: judge on (a) ranked savings with numbers, (b) trade-offs disclosed honestly per item, (c) at least one of the three is an optimization beyond what OZ MerkleDistributor already does (otherwise the answer adds nothing).

success_criteria.name: three_ranked_with_numbers
success_criteria.description: EXACTLY three optimizations, each with a numeric gas estimate and ranked. 'A few options' fails.

success_criteria.name: tradeoffs_per_item
success_criteria.description: Each of the three has a named trade-off (security, ABI, complexity, replay). Generic 'standard caveats' fails.

success_criteria.name: beyond_oz_baseline
success_criteria.description: At least one optimization is a real improvement over OZ MerkleDistributor (which already packs bitmaps). Restating OZ as 'savings' fails.
